description: This source file implements RBUS handler functions for WAN interface traffic statistics within the WTC (WAN Traffic Counter) module. It contains get, set, event subscription handlers for Ulong and String parameters, and row management handlers for a table of WAN interface instances.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableUlongGetHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusGetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles retrieval of unsigned long parameters for WAN traffic statistics for a specific interface instance.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableUlongSetHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusSetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles setting of unsigned long parameters for WAN traffic statistics for a specific interface instance.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableUlongEventSubHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusEventSubAction_t action,const char * eventName,rbusFilter_t filter,int32_t interval,bool * autoPublish)
methods.description: Handles event subscriptions for unsigned long parameters in the WAN traffic interface table.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableStringGetHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusGetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles retrieval of string parameters from the WAN traffic interface table.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableStringSetHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusSetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles setting of string parameters in the WAN traffic interface table.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableStringEventSubHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusEventSubAction_t action,const char * eventName,rbusFilter_t filter,int32_t interval,bool * autoPublish)
methods.description: Handles event subscriptions for string parameters in the WAN traffic interface table.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableAddRowHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * tableName,char const * aliasName,uint32_t * instNum)
methods.description: Handles adding new rows to the WAN interface table, assigning a new instance number.

methods.name: rbusError_t WTC_TableRemoveRowHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * rowName)
methods.description: Handles removal of rows from the WAN interface table.
